controlBlock.name: ecvt_boostinfo
controlBlock.description: Valid only when CVTBoost is on

ecvt_iplboosts_activated.description: All IPL boosts to be activated have been activated.

ecvt_sdboosts_activated.description: All Shutdown boosts to be activated have been activated.

ecvt_rpboosts_activated.description: All RP boosts to be activated have been activated. This bit will be turned off once the boost ends.

ecvt_boostclass.description: See Ecvt_BoostClass_xxx equates. Valid only when one of the boosts is active

ecvt_sysparm_ziipboost.description: According to the availability and the BOOST system parameter, we want to do zIIP boost. This gets turned off if it could never be right to activate, such as for the case of a non-dedicated partition

ecvt_sysparm_speedboost.description: According to the availability and the BOOST system parameter, we want to do speed boost.

controlBlock.name: ecvt_boostinfo_transientziipcores
controlBlock.description: Number of zIIP cores configured online for the zIIP boost. Those cores will be configured offline at the end of the zIIP boost. Valid only when the zIIP boost active bit is on.

ecvt_rpb_disabled.description: When on, RP boosts are disabled When off, RP boosts are enabled

controlBlock.name: ecvt_boostlevel
controlBlock.description: 0: initial deliverable >0: In addition to initial deliverable data,

controlBlock.name: ecvt_boostinfo_expected_endetod
controlBlock.description: Time (STCKE format) when boost(s) will end. It is valid when the following is true: -- one of the "Boost Active" bits is on, and -- if the boost class is IPL, bit Ecvt_IplBoosts_Activated is on, and -- if the boost class is shutdown, bit Ecvt_SDBoosts_Activated is on, and -- if the boost class is RP, bit Ecvt_RPBoosts_Activated is on. End time can be extended if there are

controlBlock.name: ecvt_boostinfo_v1
controlBlock.description: Recovery process boost support. Valid when Ecvt_BoostLevel is at least Ecvt_BoostLevel_V1

controlBlock.name: ecvt_rpboosts_num
controlBlock.description: Number of recovery-process boost start requests received across the life of the IPL that were not during IPL boost or shutdown boost

controlBlock.name: ecvt_rpboosts_num_ignored
controlBlock.description: Number of recovery-process boost start requests received across the life of the IPL that were ignored because the duration limit had been exceeded

controlBlock.name: ecvt_rpb_duration
controlBlock.description: Total duration for the life of the IPL of recovery process boosts. Updated when RP boost is extended or ends. In STCK format.

controlBlock.name: ecvt_rp_duration
controlBlock.description: Same as Ecvt_RPB_Duration

controlBlock.name: ecvt_rp_boostinfo_flags1
controlBlock.description: Same as Ecvt_RPB_BoostInfo_Flags1

ecvt_rpboosts_last_endedbytimer.description: The last RPBoost(s) ended by timer. Valid only when RPBoost inactive.

ecvt_rpboosts_last_endedbyshutdown.description: The last RPBoost(s) ended due to shutdown. Valid only when RPBoost inactive.

ecvt_rpboosts_last_endedbyerror.description: The last RPBoost(s) ended due to error. Valid only when RPBoost inactive.

controlBlock.name: ecvt_rpboosts_requestor_id
controlBlock.description: The requestor ID associated with the start or extend. Updated when the boost is extended. Valid only when RP boost(s) are active. See equates ECVT_RPBReq_xxx

controlBlock.name: ecvt_rpboosts_numbyrequestor_addr
controlBlock.description: Address of an area that has the number of RP boost requests by each requestor. The format of the area is: 1st word - number of entries. 2nd word - number of requests by unidentified requestors. Nth word when N > 2 - number of requests by requestor N-2. The requestors are described by ID (the "N-2" value).

controlBlock.name: ecvt_rpboosts_num_whiledis
controlBlock.description: Number of recovery-process boost start requests received across the life of the IPL while RP boosts were disabled

controlBlock.name: ecvt_rpb_duration_potential
controlBlock.description: Total duration for the life of the IPL of recovery process boosts. Includes time that would have been boosted except for having reached the duration limit. Includes time regardless of whether or not RP boosts were enabled. Updated when RP boost would be extended or end. In STCK format.

controlBlock.name: ecvt_rpb_duration_potential_e
controlBlock.description: Same as preceding field, but only while RP Boosts are enabled

controlBlock.name: ecvt_rpb_en_dis_local_timestamp
controlBlock.description: Local time when RP boosts were last enabled or disabled. In STCK format.

controlBlock.name: ecvtr430
controlBlock.description: Reserved

controlBlock.name: ecvt_ziipboostcoresaddr
controlBlock.description: When not 0, the address of an area that is a bit string of which cores were config'd online for a boost. Each bit corresponds to a core (bit 0 is core 0, bit 1 is core 1, etc). When bit n is on, core n is considered a zIIP boost core

controlBlock.name: ecvt_ifunc_addr
controlBlock.description: Address of area mapped by IHAIFUNC indicating which function codes of such instructions as PRNO, KIMD, KLMD are available.

controlBlock.name: ecvtr43c
controlBlock.description: Reserved

controlBlock.name: ecvt_maxtod
controlBlock.description: A value that will not be reached by the clock comparator for this IPL. That is x'FFFFFFFF_FFFFFFFF' when a signed CC is not used, x'7FFFFFFF_FFFFFFFF' when a signed CC is used
